At BlinkBuy, your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you visit our website, create an account, browse products, place orders, or use any of our services.

By using BlinkBuy, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

1. Information We Collect

When you use our website, we may collect information that you provide directly to us, including:

  • Full name

  • Email address

  • Phone number

  • Billing and shipping address

  • Account login information

  • Order and purchase history

  • Product reviews and feedback

  • Information provided when contacting customer support

We may also automatically collect certain technical information, such as your IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited, and general website usage information.

2. How We Use Your Information

BlinkBuy may use your information to:

  • Create and manage your account

  • Process and confirm your orders

  • Deliver products to your provided address

  • Process payments through available payment services

  • Provide customer support

  • Send order confirmations and delivery updates

  • Improve our website, products, and services

  • Prevent fraud, unauthorized access, and other misuse

  • Maintain website security

  • Comply with applicable legal requirements

We use your information only for legitimate business and service-related purposes.

3. Payment Information

When you make a payment through BlinkBuy, payment information may be processed by third-party payment providers. Depending on the payment method and service provider, BlinkBuy may not directly store your complete debit card, credit card, or banking credentials.

Payment providers may have their own privacy policies and security practices. We recommend reviewing their policies before completing a transaction.

4. Cookies

BlinkBuy may use cookies and similar technologies to improve your browsing experience.

Cookies may help us:

  • Keep you logged into your account

  • Remember shopping preferences

  • Maintain your shopping cart

  • Understand how visitors use our website

  • Improve website performance and functionality

You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings. However, disabling certain cookies may affect some website features.

5. How We Share Your Information

BlinkBuy does not sell your personal information simply because you use our website.

We may share necessary information with trusted service providers who help us operate our business, including:

  • Payment processing providers

  • Delivery and shipping partners

  • Website hosting providers

  • Technology and analytics providers

  • Customer support services

We may also disclose information when required by law or when necessary to protect BlinkBuy, our customers, or our services from fraud, security threats, or unauthorized activity.

6. Data Security

We take reasonable steps to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, misuse, alteration, loss, or disclosure.

However, no website, online service, or method of electronic transmission can be guaranteed to be completely secure. Therefore, while we work to protect your information, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

7. Data Retention

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary to provide our services, process transactions, maintain business records, resolve disputes, prevent fraud, and meet applicable legal requirements.

When information is no longer required, we may securely delete or anonymize it where appropriate.

8. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on applicable law, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information.

These may include the right to:

  • Request access to your personal information

  • Request correction of inaccurate information

  • Request deletion of certain information

  • Ask about how your information is being used

  • Withdraw certain permissions where applicable

To make a privacy-related request, please contact the BlinkBuy support team using the contact information available on our website.

9. Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites, services, or payment platforms. These websites operate independently from BlinkBuy and may have their own privacy policies.

BlinkBuy is not responsible for the privacy practices, content, or security of third-party websites. We recommend reading their privacy policies before providing them with personal information.

10. Children's Privacy

BlinkBuy does not intentionally collect personal information from children in circumstances where such collection is prohibited by applicable law.

If you believe that a child has provided personal information to us improperly, please contact us so that we can take appropriate action.

11. Changes to This Privacy Policy

BlinkBuy may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our services, technology, security practices, or applicable legal requirements.

When we make changes, we will update the Last Updated date displayed at the top of this page. We encourage you to review this page periodically to stay informed about how we protect your information.

12. Contact Us

If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or the way BlinkBuy handles your information, please contact our customer support team through the contact details provided on our website.

Thank you for trusting BlinkBuy with your information.
